From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Northvale C-suite Workshop — Arrival & EA Coordination

Hi all,

We have Marcus Green (CEO) and Priya Shah (CPO) from Northvale arriving for the 4/10 workshop. I'd like to lock down EA-level assignments and on-site logistics so the exec experience is seamless. Quick ask list below — please reply with confirmations or edits by EOD today: 

- Flights/arrival: Marcus lands SFO 4/10 10:05am (UA 244). Priya lands 4/10 11:30am (AA 620). Can Evelyn confirm pickup timings and car supplier?
- Hotel: Booked at The Beacon (confirmed). I attached a draft itinerary with check-in blocks and rooming. Please confirm vouchers.
- Ground: Need a car for Marcus (town car) and an SUV for Priya + 1 (luggage). Suggest meet-and-greet at Terminal 3 curb.
- EA escort & badges: Jordan, can you coordinate visitor badges + temporary access to 8th-floor boardroom?
- AV & room setup: Markus, will presenter's mic, HDMI, and Zoom room be ready by 8:00am? We need an AV check on 4/10 at 7:30am.
- Meals/dietary: Marcus — no red meat; Priya — vegetarian. Any other needs?
- Parking: Request 2 visitor spaces reserved for the day.

Attachments: draft_itinerary.xlsx (draft)

If you want to split responsibilities differently, propose swaps. I will reply to Northvale once internal owners are set.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Executive Assistant, CEO Office
Redwood Inference
phone: 415-555-0182

Tessa — thanks, this is great. Confirming a few items: 

1) Flights & ground
- UA 244 (Marcus) — car service reserved: Redwood Corporate Town Car (confirmation #RC-7781). Pickup at T3 curb 10:15am; driver will hold a sign: "Redwood / Marcus Green".
- AA 620 (Priya) — SUV reserved (RC-7782). ETA 11:30am, 2 passengers. Driver will assist with luggage.

2) Hotel 
- Beacon voucher attached (hotel_voucher.pdf). Rooms under "Redwood / Northvale". Check-in flexible; late-arrival protocol set.

3) AV 
- Markus: AV tech (Samir) assigned for 7:30am check; I booked an extra wireless lapel and HDMI dongles. Markus, confirm if you need a secondary laptop or a Mac adapter.

4) Parking & badges 
- Jordan: building security flagged that visitor spaces must be reserved 72h in advance. Please confirm badge requests to security and concierge.

5) Meals/dietary 
- Catering ordered: breakfast (hot buffet + fruit), lunch boxed + plated options (veg/vegan/gluten-free). Marcus' no red meat noted.

Attachments: hotel_voucher.pdf, car_service_booking.pdf

Hi Tessa / Jordan — thanks for the heads-up and for setting this up. A few notes from our side: 

- Marcus & Priya appreciate the timing. Marcus would like a quick 15-min private check-in with Redwood's CEO before the 9:00am session on 4/10 if that's possible. If your CEO is available, please pencil that in; otherwise, we can schedule 4/11 after the workshop.
- For arrivals: Marcus will carry a small carry-on only; Priya has a checked bag. Both have TSA Pre. Drivers should look for "Northvale" in addition to names.
- Dietary: Priya is vegetarian and cannot have dairy at breakfast (vegan preferred). Marcus is fine with fish/ poultry.
- Parking/EV charging: Can you confirm whether guest parking spots have EV chargers? Priya will need a top-up.

Let me know if you need copies of their IDs for security (we can provide). Appreciate the AV check — we'll have a short slide deck sent to Markus tonight.

Best,
Avery

- Ground ops: Drivers will carry signs: "Redwood / Marcus Green" and "Northvale / Priya Shah". Car confirmations are in Evelyn's attachments.

Next steps: Tessa to send a single combined note to Avery with pick-up details, CEO meet time, and final meeting room link. Evelyn/Markus/Jordan — please be on standby 7:15–9:30am on 4/10.
